findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: A caller that observes a nil cache under the read lock will always load and replace the manifest after it later acquires the write lock, even if another caller populated the cache while it was waiting. During a concurrent production cold start, every request that arrived before the first load completes therefore performs a separate, serialized manifest read instead of using the newly cached result. This can turn one cache miss into N sequential filesystem operations and can also allow a later transient read failure to replace an already valid cached value with nil. After acquiring the write lock, check `cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil` again and return the cached value before loading.
